parts.html: The K-05 kitchen model combines timeless classical styling, a soft beige color palette, and contemporary furniture technology to create an elegant and welcoming kitchen interior.

Its coordinated painted cabinet fronts bring visual harmony to the space, while the neutral beige finish complements a variety of interior materials, including natural wood, decorative stone, and light-colored wall finishes.

The L-shaped configuration provides an efficient arrangement of working surfaces, cabinet storage, and built-in appliances. Without a kitchen island, the layout preserves valuable floor space and allows greater flexibility when planning dining and circulation areas.
The porcelain stoneware countertop introduces a distinctive material texture, complementing the painted cabinet fronts and enhancing the kitchen's refined appearance.
With a total linear length of 6.2 meters, the K-05 model offers a practical furniture arrangement suitable for apartments and private residences.
The upper and lower cabinet fronts feature a painted finish, while the cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.

For everyday convenience, the kitchen includes Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges and concealed Muller Profi Line drawer runners, supporting smooth cabinet operation and comfortable access to kitchen essentials.
Furniture handles are included in the configuration.
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, offers custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for residential properties in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-05 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, appliance requirements, storage preferences, and architectural features.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-05 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a timeless interior that combines classical elegance with modern everyday convenience.
